Kuber Cards

Store card details encrypted on-device, hidden behind biometrics. No network, ever.

A private vault for all your card details. You can store as many cards as desired. Free tier allows just two cards to be added, but there is no such limit on the Pro version of the app. Everything is encrypted and stored on your device, locked behind biometric access. Kuber never sends card data over any network.

Kuber Notes

A smart notepad with inline arithmetic calculations. Type 'total' or '=' to calculate results, and tap numbers to log transactions, loans, or ledger entries.

Kuber Notes works just like a familiar notepad, but with powerful financial arithmetic built right into your text.

  • Inline Calculations: Write expressions, discounts, or quantities like 220 * 4 = and watch Kuber compute the result in real time.
  • Smart Totals: Type "total" or "=" on a new line and Kuber smartly calculates the sum of your listed items.
  • One-Tap Actions: Tap any highlighted number or calculated total to instantly convert it into a transaction, a loan, or a lent/borrowed ledger entry.
  • Private & Protected: Your notes live strictly on your device and can be secured with biometrics or app lock.

Type or speak to log multiple transactions at once. Parse amounts, merchants, and categories on-device from the home widget or full screen.

Voice Quick Add

Beta

Say what you spent and Kuber logs it. Accessed directly through Quick Add for effortless, hands-free tracking.

Speak naturally and Kuber transforms your words into transactions in seconds, completely hands-free.

  • Integrated into Quick Add: Voice input is accessible directly through Quick Add. Tap the microphone icon on the home feed widget or switch to voice mode in full-screen Quick Add.
  • 100% On-Device & Private: Speech recognition runs entirely on your device. Audio never leaves your phone or touches external servers.
  • Natural Language Parsing: Say everyday sentences like "250 on groceries" or "400 for petrol" and Kuber automatically fills in the amount, category, and date for your confirmation.

Powerful Filtering

Filter your finances any way you want—by keyword search, accounts, categories, tags, amount ranges (min/max), transaction types, or custom date ranges.

Drill into your spending with total precision. Kuber lets you filter your transactions however you want, combining multiple criteria without friction:

  • Instant Keyword Search: Search across transaction names, notes, and merchant labels.
  • Account & Category Filters: Multi-select specific accounts (Cash, Bank, Credit Card) and categories to view exact spending slices.
  • Min / Max Amount Range: Set minimum and maximum thresholds to isolate big-ticket items or inspect small recurring charges.
  • Tag Filtering: Isolate specific events or projects with custom tags like #trip, #renovation, or #medical.
  • Custom Date Ranges: Select any date interval to compare past periods and audit specific timeframes.
  • Type Toggles: Switch between Expenses, Incomes, Transfers, and Recurring items with one tap.
  • Live Net Totals: As you filter, the summary header recalculates in real time—showing the exact transaction count, total expenses, total income, and net balance.

G2.1Tools & Calculators · /features/calculators/Web v1 · 1440 · Signature light
KuberHomeFeaturesDocsAboutPress
install_mobileGet the app
Featureschevron_rightTools & Calculators
calculate

Tools & Calculators

Over 25 built-in financial calculators for borrowing, taxes, investments, and planning. Save any calculation to revisit and compare anytime.

Plan, compare, and forecast your finances with a comprehensive suite of offline tools:

  • Save Any Calculation: Bookmark results from any calculator to revisit later. Your saved scenarios (such as home loan estimates or investment goals) stay pinned right at the top for instant access.
  • Almost All Kinds of Calculators: Choose from more than 25 dedicated calculators spanning every financial scenario:
    • Borrowing: EMI calculator, loan comparisons, and prepayment impact analysis.
    • Tax and Salary: In-depth salary breakdowns comparing old vs new tax regimes, HRA exemptions, and GST.
    • Planning and Wealth: Goal planners, retirement corpus estimates, and lumpsum vs SIP growth.
    • Daily Utilities: Bill splitters, currency converters, discount checks, and inflation math.
  • Visual Breakdowns and Schedules: View principal vs interest donut charts, balance-over-time curves, and full yearly or monthly amortization schedules.
  • Completely Private and Offline: All maths and saved records stay strictly on your phone with zero network calls.

G2.2Detailed Analytics · /features/detailed-analytics/Web v1 · 1440 · Signature light

install_mobileGet the app
Featureschevron_rightDetailed Analytics
insert_chart

Detailed Analytics

Core charts, weekly heatmaps, and category breakdowns are free forever. Unlock financial health scores and predictive patterns with Advanced Analytics (Pro).

Gain a complete understanding of your money habits with a mix of free core visual analytics and deep Pro-tier pattern intelligence:

Core Analytics (Free for Everyone)

The dedicated Analytics tab in Kuber provides instant, interactive insights without requiring a paid subscription:

  • Income and Expense Comparisons: Toggle between Day, Week, or Month scales, and switch between Bar or Line charts to track net cash flow across any date range.
  • Average Weekly Heatmap: See which days of the week you spend the most, complete with intensity blocks and precise daily average figures.
  • Transaction Size Distribution: Understand your spending profile across ticket sizes: Small (<₹500), Medium (₹500 - ₹2,000), and Large (>₹2,000).
  • Spending by Category and Group: Interactive donut charts highlighting category share percentages, totals, and group-level rollups.
  • Tag-wise Analytics and Top Spends: Track project or event costs using tags like #trip, #family, or #work, and instantly view your biggest transactions.

Advanced Analytics (Kuber Pro Feature)

For users who want deeper financial diagnosis, Advanced Analytics adds algorithmic intelligence:

  • Financial Health Score: Get an overarching score out of 100 with granular grading across your Savings Rate (out of 20), Expense Ratio (out of 20), Budget Adherence (out of 20), and Emergency Fund runway (out of 20).
  • Behavioral Spending Patterns: Discover subtle habits automatically (such as peak spending days, time-of-day tendencies, and recurring spikes).
  • Predictive Forecasting and Cash Flow: Intelligent month-end spending estimates, savings rate projections, and year-over-year growth comparisons.
  • Anomaly Detection: Flags unusual transactions and sudden spending surges before they disrupt your monthly goals.

100% On-Device and Private

Every chart, ratio, and machine learning insight runs strictly on your smartphone. Your private transaction logs and net balances never leave your device.

Recurring Transactions

Automate repeating income and expenses like monthly salaries, rent, and subscriptions with customizable frequencies and auto-processing.

Automate your regular cash flow and keep your records completely up to date without daily manual logging:

  • Automated Inflows and Outflows: Set up recurring rules for regular credits (monthly salary, freelancing retainers, rental income) or regular debits (Netflix subscriptions, gym memberships, house rent, utility bills).
  • Flexible Recurrence Frequencies: Choose schedules that match your obligations:
    • Standard Intervals: Daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or yearly.
    • Custom Day Cycles: Specify exact custom intervals (such as every 45 days).
  • Monthly Net Cash Flow at a Glance: The dedicated overview card shows your net monthly recurring balance (total monthly income minus recurring expenses) and alerts you to upcoming charges due in the next few days.
  • Background Auto-Execution: Kuber automatically logs the transaction when the due date arrives, crediting or debiting the selected bank account or card with the correct category.
  • End Conditions and Lifespans: Keep rules active indefinitely, or automatically stop them after a set number of occurrences or on a specific end date.
  • Pause and Resume Any Time: Temporarily halt rules (like a paused gym membership) without deleting them, preserving your setup until you are ready to resume.
  • Connected to Upcoming Events: Recurring rules feed seamlessly into the Upcoming Events calendar and widget, so you always know when your next debit or salary credit is approaching.

G4.1Investments · /features/investments/Web v1 · 1440 · Signature light
KuberHomeFeaturesDocsAboutPress
install_mobileGet the app
Featureschevron_rightInvestments
trending_up

Investments

Track your complete investment portfolio across mutual funds, stocks, SIPs, gold, FDs, crypto, and real estate with real-time P&L insights.

Consolidate all your investments alongside your day-to-day accounts for a complete view of your wealth:

  • Diverse Asset Support: Track existing holdings or log new assets across a wide range of categories:
    • Mutual Funds and SIPs: Equity, debt, index, and flexi-cap mutual funds.
    • Stocks and Equities: Individual shares and market holdings.
    • ETFs and Bonds: Exchange-traded funds, government bonds, and corporate debentures.
    • Fixed Deposits (FD) and Recurring Deposits (RD): Guaranteed-return bank and post office deposits.
    • Gold and Precious Metals: Digital gold, sovereign gold bonds (SGB), and physical gold.
    • Real Estate and Property: Land, residential, and commercial investments.
    • Crypto and Web3 Assets: Cryptocurrencies and digital tokens.
    • Collectibles and Custom Assets: Art, watches, vintage items, and other bespoke holdings.
  • Unrealized Gain and P&L Tracking: Update current market valuations to instantly view your total portfolio value, invested capital, absolute gains or losses, and percentage returns.
  • Automated Monthly SIP Deductions: Set up recurring SIP investments with automated account debits on your preferred day of the month (days 1 to 28).
  • Visual Asset Allocation: View an immediate breakdown of your portfolio across asset classes to ensure your target risk profile stays balanced.
  • Folio Notes and Investment Details: Store folio numbers, broker references, maturity dates, and personal investment theses inside individual notes.
  • Private and Offline: Keep your complete net worth and portfolio allocation private on your phone without linking credentials or sharing data with aggregators.

G4.2Lent and Borrowed · /features/lent-borrowed/Web v1 · 1440 · Signature light

Featureschevron_rightLent and Borrowed
handshake

Lent and Borrowed

Track money lent to friends or borrowed from others, with smart contact suggestions from previous ledger history and clean settlement tracking.

Keep peer-to-peer debts, shared expenses, and informal loans clear without awkward guesswork or forgotten balances:

  • Two-Way Ledger: Record both sides of personal transactions:
    • Lent: Money you have given to friends, family, or colleagues that you will receive back.
    • Borrowed: Money you have taken or owe to someone else that you need to return.
  • Smart Contact Suggestions: As you type a person's name, Kuber automatically suggests contacts from your previous ledger records. Suggestions display past history, whether previous balances are settled, and remaining amounts, saving you from re-typing names or creating duplicate contacts.
  • Duplicate Entry Warnings: Kuber warns you if an unsettled ledger entry already exists for a contact, helping you prevent accidental double-entries.
  • Net Position Summary: An overview card instantly calculates your overall net standing: total money you will receive versus total money you owe, highlighting whether your net position is in your favour.
  • Partial Repayments and One-Tap Settlement: Track partial payments over time with progress indicators (such as percentage received or remaining balance), and mark entries settled with a single tap once squared up.
  • Due Dates and Reminders: Attach expected settlement dates to feed into Upcoming Events and system notifications for timely follow-ups.
  • Account Integration and Notes: Link ledger entries to your bank or cash accounts, and keep contextual notes on what the money was lent or borrowed for.

Budgets

Category-based spending limits with live progress tracking, customizable threshold alerts, and historical trend reviews.

Plan your monthly spending and avoid overshooting category limits with clear progress indicators and timely alerts:

  • Category Spending Limits: Create custom budget caps for specific expense categories such as Groceries, Dining Out, Entertainment, Shopping, or Utilities.
  • Live Progress Tracking: Watch real-time visual progress bars fill up with every logged expense, showing total spent, remaining allowance, and days left in the billing period.
  • Custom Alert Thresholds: Set up warnings at key milestones (like 50%, 80%, or 100% of your limit) or custom monetary amounts to receive notifications before you overspend.
  • Recurring Monthly Plans: Budgets automatically reset and roll over at the start of each month, or can be configured for custom date spans.
  • Budget History and Cycles: Review past monthly performance in the history sheet to see where spending stays disciplined and where limits need tuning.
  • Pause or Resume Anytime: Temporarily pause a budget (for example during holidays or travel) without deleting its historical records.
  • Home Feed Widget: Keep your active budgets front and center by enabling the Budgets widget directly on your dashboard.

currency_exchange

Currency Support

Track your finances in your chosen currency worldwide with native symbol formatting and a built-in currency converter.

Manage your finances in the currency that fits your life, with simple global configuration and dedicated conversion tools:

  • Single Primary Currency Tracking: Kuber currently tracks all accounts, transactions, budgets, and investments in one chosen primary currency at a time. This keeps your net worth calculations, analytics, and category rollups completely consistent and accurate.
  • Global Currency Selection: Choose from any worldwide currency in Settings, including INR (₹), USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), JPY (¥), CAD, AUD, AED, SGD, and dozens more.
  • Localized Symbols and Separators: Switching your primary currency automatically updates currency symbols, comma separators, and decimal formatting across every dashboard, card, and report.
  • Built-In Currency Converter: When traveling abroad or checking foreign prices, use the built-in Currency Converter under Tools & Calculators for instant conversions between world currencies.
  • Always Free and Offline: Currency selection is completely free for all users and works entirely on-device without requiring account logins or cloud syncing.

Multi-lingual

Beta

Experience Kuber in your preferred language with beta support for 9 regional Indian languages and English.

Manage your personal finances comfortably in your native tongue with extensive regional language support:

  • 9 Supported Languages (Beta): Choose from a curated selection of Indian regional languages alongside English:
    • English
    • हिन्दी (Hindi)
    • मराठी (Marathi)
    • ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (Punjabi)
    • বাংলা (Bengali)
    • తెలుగు (Telugu)
    • தமிழ் (Tamil)
    • മലയാളം (Malayalam)
    • ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada)
  • Native Script Rendering: All buttons, categories, transaction types, analytical summaries, and system dialogs render cleanly in native regional typography.
  • One-Tap Switching: Change languages instantly inside Settings without needing to restart the app or migrate any data.
  • Active Beta Translations: Regional localizations are actively evolving in beta, continuously refined based on user suggestions and real-world usage.
  • Private and Completely Offline: Every translation dictionary is bundled directly with the application, ensuring your localized experience requires zero network requests.

import_export

Import and Export

Export statements and full database backups in CSV or JSON, restore previous records, or test features with sandbox mock data.

Take complete ownership of your personal finance data with versatile local import, export, and sandbox capabilities:

  • Full Data Ownership: Your records belong exclusively to you, stored securely on your phone with zero vendor lock-in.
  • Export Transaction Statements (History Tab):
    • Generate filtered transaction statements directly from the History tab.
    • Export in spreadsheet-ready CSV (for analysis in Excel, Google Sheets, or custom scripts) or beautifully formatted PDF (with monthly summaries, category totals, and debit/credit styling).
  • Full Database Backups (Settings -> Data Management):
    • Export Data: Create complete snapshots of your accounts, categories, tags, transactions, loans, investments, and recurring rules in structured JSON or CSV format.
    • Import Data: Seamlessly restore previously exported backups or migrate from external expense tools with one tap.
  • Sandbox Mock Data:
    • Generate Mock Data: Populate Kuber with realistic mock accounts, categories, and test transactions to explore charts, heatmaps, and financial health scores without manually typing data.
    • Clear Mock Data: Wipe test records cleanly at any time from the Danger Zone to begin logging your genuine finances.
  • 100% Private and Offline: All statement generation, JSON serialization, and CSV parsing run locally on your phone without ever uploading files to external cloud servers.

Kuber Pro

Everything Kuber Pro unlocks, including advanced analytics, unlimited SMS imports, automated backups, and expanded usage limits.

Kuber is crafted as an offline, private financial companion funded directly by user support. Core features stay free forever, while Kuber Pro unlocks advanced analytical tools, automation, and unlimited usage limits:

What Pro Includes

| Feature | Free | Pro | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Advanced Features | | | | Advanced Analytics | Basic charts | Full trends + filters | | SMS Import | 5 per week | Unlimited | | Reminders | Not included | Included | | Automatic Backups | Manual only | Automatic | | Custom Themes | Signature only | 7 themes | | Usage Limits | | | | Kuber Notes | 2 notes | Unlimited | | Ask Kuber | 5 per week | Unlimited | | Kuber Cards | 2 cards | Unlimited | | Always Free for Everyone | | | | Core Features | All included | All included |

---

Key Pro Advantages

  • Unlimited Automation and Intelligence:
    • Unlimited SMS Import: Parse all your bank alerts automatically every day without weekly caps.
    • Unlimited Ask Kuber: Query your financial assistant anytime for instant spending breakdowns, budget checks, and smart answers.
    • Automated Google Drive Backups: Protect your financial history effortlessly with scheduled background backups.
  • Deeper Financial Insights:
    • Advanced Analytics: Unlock full trend timelines, financial health scores, expense ratio breakdowns, and custom date range filters.
  • Reminders and Customization:
    • Bill and EMI Reminders: Get timely device notifications for credit cards, loan EMIs, rent, and custom dues.
    • 7 Handcrafted Themes: Customize the app with vibrant OLED themes including Obsidian, Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Amber, Violet, and Rose.
  • Uncapped Storage:
    • Keep unlimited private notes and store unlimited loyalty or membership cards.
  • Solo Developer Backing:
    • Every subscription directly funds the solo developer building Kuber as a privacy-focused, ad-free, account-free financial tool.
  • Promo Code Redemption:
    • Redeem promotional codes directly within the Pro screen for complimentary access.
